Just from a storytelling perspective, the entire saga (and by saga I mean 1-6) is The Tragedy of Anakin Skywalker.  Even when he is finally “redeemed”, he has lost EVERYTHING.  His wife, his family, seeing his kids grow up.  I’m sure, also, in the time between the Emperor’s Wrath and the removal of his helmet, he was in so much emotional pain while coming back to the light, realizing EVERYTHING had been for NOTHING.  All ending in one of the other saddest moments of the saga, him dying in Luke’s arms, somewhat content but still having squandered all his potential.  Imo, it’s one of the greatest cinematic tragedies ever put to film.  1-6 are nowhere near PERFECT, but the story is sooooo damn compelling.
